text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0836 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$1.50 a tonne higher on CBOT soy complex calls. Funds widely expected to resume rolling July positions to November. Light hedges seen at the open in response to premiums offered on Wednesday at country elevators. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -4.60 Thursday from -8.94 Wednesday. Hot, dry weather on the eastern Prairies were support futures if the region does not see rain next week. The Canadian dollar was up to C$1.3814 versus the U.S. dollar, and rose to 82.76 yen and 1.5198 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on rumoured tightness in the July seen prompting short covering.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn calls as Alberta Wheat Pool expected to sell July-Oct spread at C$2.
Steady to C$0.50 higher on allied markets and oversold sentiments from Thursday's lower close.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
